chapter: Central High, first records and leaving home
title: Selling the family piano and getting rid of her music after her mother died
summary: She describes singing on the porch as a girl, then how after her mother passed she sold the upright piano for $10 and discarded records, a Basie-gift record player and music. Dance defers the subject.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
